// divider test vectors
// format: a(hex) b(hex) div_op(dec) quotient(hex) remainder(hex) cycles_in_ex(dec)
// div_op: 0 DIV, 1 DIVU, 2 REM, 3 REMU (signed when div_op[0] = 0); both results are checked
// cycles_in_ex: start cycle to the cycle done is seen, i.e. how long the DIV sits in EX:
//   35 on the normal path, 2 on the fast path (divide by zero, 80000000 / FFFFFFFF signed)
//
// reference cases
00000014 00000004 0 00000005 00000000 35
FFFFFFEC 00000004 0 FFFFFFFB 00000000 35
00000014 00000003 0 00000006 00000002 35
FFFFFFEC 00000003 2 FFFFFFFA FFFFFFFE 35
00000014 FFFFFFFD 2 FFFFFFFA 00000002 35
FFFFFFFF 00000002 1 7FFFFFFF 00000001 35
00001234 00000000 2 FFFFFFFF 00001234 2
80000000 FFFFFFFF 2 80000000 00000000 2
FFFFFFFF 80000001 1 00000001 7FFFFFFE 35
80000000 FFFFFFFF 3 00000000 80000000 35
// both corner cases for every div_op (DIVU/REMU take the normal path for 80000000 / FFFFFFFF)
00000007 00000000 0 FFFFFFFF 00000007 2
80000000 00000000 0 FFFFFFFF 80000000 2
80000000 FFFFFFFF 0 80000000 00000000 2
00000007 00000000 1 FFFFFFFF 00000007 2
80000000 00000000 1 FFFFFFFF 80000000 2
80000000 FFFFFFFF 1 00000000 80000000 35
00000007 00000000 2 FFFFFFFF 00000007 2
80000000 00000000 2 FFFFFFFF 80000000 2
80000000 FFFFFFFF 2 80000000 00000000 2
00000007 00000000 3 FFFFFFFF 00000007 2
80000000 00000000 3 FFFFFFFF 80000000 2
80000000 FFFFFFFF 3 00000000 80000000 35
